content.trans: 酵母本身是活的。

content.text: It's an animal.
content.trans: 它是动物。

content.text: It's like a bacteria.
content.trans: 是细菌。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: And so you wonder why are some breads flat and why are some breads big, poofy, large?
content.trans: 您为什么想知道为什么有些面包是扁的，为什么有些面包大，蓬松的？

content.text: Well, yeast is why.
content.trans: 英语：好，酵母是为什么。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: Basically, you can't have a big poofy bread, a big large tall bread, unless you have this yeast.
content.trans: 基本来说，你不能有这么大的一个大面包，这样的大大的高高的大面包除非你有这个酵母。

content.text: So yeast is what makes the bread rise.
content.trans: 所以酵母是使面团发酵的原因。

content.text: Yes.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: And we also mentioned flour, which is basically just a powder made out of some type of grain usually.
content.trans: 我们还提到了面粉，这是一种通常由某种类型的谷物制成的粉末。

content.text: Yeah, usually it's made out of wheat.
content.trans: 是的，通常它是由小麦制成的。

content.text: Obviously, whole wheat is a little bit different from the white flour, which would be a different processed wheat.
content.trans: 当然，全麦是一种稍微不同于白粉的加工小麦。这将是一个不同的加工小麦。

content.text: But we also have different things that you can even have rice flour.
content.trans: 但是我们还有其他东西，你甚至可以有大米。

content.text: Right corn flour.
content.trans: 正确答案：正确答案：右角面粉。

content.text: Corn flour.
content.trans: 玉米面。

content.text: So corn bread would be, of course, yellow, because corn is yellow.
content.trans: 所以玉米面当然会是黄色的，因为玉米是黄色的。

content.text: Now, so you can hear that we say the word flour, like a rose is a flour, but it's actually spelled different.
content.trans: 现在，所以你可以听到我们说的“面粉”，比如玫瑰是“面粉”，但实际上拼写不同。

content.text: F-L-O-U-R flour.
content.trans: F-L-O-U-R 面粉。

content.text: So there's two different things.
content.trans: 所以有两件不同的事情。

content.text: There's flowers in your garden, and there's flour, F-L-O-U-R, which is something you can cook with.
content.trans: 花园里有花，还有面粉，F-L-O-U-R，这是你用面粉做的东西。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: These are called homophones, so they basically have the same pronunciation, but very different spellings.
content.trans: 这些被称为同音词，所以它们基本上发音相同，但字形不同。

content.text: And very different meanings.
content.trans: 英语：和非常不同的含义。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: So a very interesting lesson for us today.
content.trans: 所以今天的学习非常有趣。

content.text: Go out, get some bread.
content.trans: 英语：出门，买点面包。

content.text: Try some of these if you have them available, but also come to the questions and comments section and tell us about maybe your local bread.
content.trans: 试试这些，如果有的话，也可以去留言区和大家分享一下你的本地面包。

content.text: I know that many countries around the world have very specific types of bread.
content.trans: 英语：我知道许多国家都有非常特定的面包类型。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 正确。

content.text: Right, some names down for us.
content.trans: 正确，我们有一些名字。

content.text: Send us your pictures, and we'll see you on the website.
content.trans: 发送你的照片，我们将见你在线。

content.text: All right. Bye guys.
content.trans: 英语：一切好。再见大家。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 拜。
